repository.mission: Build a local-first, human-governed autonomous development workshop where agents can perform long-duration coding, testing, documentation, graph, and review-preparation work while preserving human control at risk boundaries.

core_invariants: Dashboard views are projections, not authority.
HyperKanban is a compact operational projection.
No protected branch mutation without explicit human approval.
No public endpoint exposure by default.
No work is done without evidence.
No prior chat history should be required for cold-start agents.

roadmap_phases.name: Agent-operable grammar
exit_criteria: me.md routes agents to the contract

roadmap_phases.name: Schema registry and validation metabolism
exit_criteria: Fixtures cover success and failure cases

roadmap_phases.name: Deterministic HyperKanban CI dashboard
exit_criteria: Dashboard is generated from repo artifacts
Every recommendation includes a reason chain

roadmap_phases.name: Agent arrival and swarm constraints
exit_criteria: Fresh agents can orient without chat history
Mutable tasks have role, budget, lease, evidence, and handoff requirements

roadmap_phases.name: Runtime control plane
exit_criteria: Runtime state exists outside model context
Trace IDs connect decisions and evidence

roadmap_phases.name: Proxmox Workshop Node implementation
exit_criteria: Local LLM health check emits reports

roadmap_phases.name: Operations and long-term maintenance
exit_criteria: Retention audit is read-only by default
Artifact integrity and environment drift can be checked

adaptive_damage_model.response: mark local-model tasks blocked and route docs/schema tasks to fallback
block dependent implementation and update schema registry or migration notes

adaptive_damage_model.symptom: two issues claim the same objective/path
adaptive_damage_model.response: mark duplicate or stale and require human decision

adaptive_damage_model.symptom: task claims done but no report/check/packet exists
adaptive_damage_model.response: mark not human-ready and route back to evidence generation
pause local-runtime-dependent work and continue docs/schema work

proxmox_optimization_path: Keep first dashboard and graph pipeline runnable without Proxmox.
Add Proxmox local node checks as optional sensor inputs.
Run schema validation and dashboard generation on the local workshop runner.
Store large reports/artifacts locally and summarize to GitHub.
Use local LLM health checks to select local versus cloud model routing.
Use resource budgets to avoid overloading local CPU/RAM/GPU.
Treat Proxmox node health as part of the repository self-model.
